svg.title: Four ways to change a training spectrogram
svg.desc: Frequency masking replaces rows. Time masking replaces columns. MixUp blends complete images and labels. CutMix replaces a rectangle and mixes labels by area. The grids are schematic, not dataset samples.

g.text: What changes in the training image?
Schematic grids. Colored regions mark edits, not measured audio values.
Blend their labels with the same weights.
Replace a rectangle with another image.
Mix labels according to the replaced area.
Masks run before resizing. MixUp or CutMix runs after normalization. Training only.
